request.query: Characteristic zero GCD domain fraction field separated Hasse Wronskian determinant factorization

items.name: IsCoprime.wronskian_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {a b : Polynomial R},
  IsCoprime a b → (a.wronskian b = 0 ↔ Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0)

items.name: IsFractionRing.charZero
items.type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R], CharZero (FractionRing R)

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_zero_left
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), Polynomial.wronskian 0 a = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_self_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), a.wronskian a = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_zero_right
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), a.wronskian 0 = 0

items.name: divRadical_dvd_wronskian_right
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (a b : Polynomial k),
  EuclideanDomain.divRadical b ∣ a.wronskian b

items.name: divRadical_dvd_wronskian_left
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (a b : Polynomial k),
  EuclideanDomain.divRadical a ∣ a.wronskian b

items.name: Polynomial.separable_gcd_right
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (Polynomial F)] {g : Polynomial F} (f : Polynomial F),
  g.Separable → (EuclideanDomain.gcd f g).Separable
